messages.subject: Observed covariance matrix
parts:
Hi all, 

Maybe I didn't search long enough but I haven't been able figure out how to generate the observed covariance matrix (= sample covariance matrix) with lavaan. I know, of course, how to generate a covariance matrix in R, but for pedagogical reasons it would be nice to have it as part of the lavaan output, preferably right before "fitted(fit)" and "resid(fit)". Suggestions?

 -- M

messages.author: a84ea074e676bde7
messages.subject: Re: Observed covariance matrix
parts:
Just found the answer, sorry.

inspectSampleCov(model, data,...)
inspect(fit, "sampstat") 

See also post from March 6, 2013.

 -- M
